rows.label: tlk70000057_05_msg0001
rows.name:
My older brother says he wants to be
a Driver when he grows up.

rows.label: tlk70000057_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I was worried, wondering
what I should become, and
Noel listened to me.

rows.label: tlk70000057_05_msg0003
rows.name:
How about keeping an eye on bad
grown-ups so they don't get any worse?

rows.label: tlk70000057_05_msg0004
rows.name:
So for now, I think I'll watch Ivan
to make sure he doesn't sneak snacks.
